overview: 2026年，UEM Sunrise 与 AME Development 成立合资公司，在 Gerbang Nusajaya 开发综合管理工业园，并处置约402.106英亩土地；同时通过开发权协议将吉隆坡KLCC一幅1.59英亩商业地交予EXSIM开发，收取4.15亿马币保证权益；此外在墨尔本Collingwood推进build-to-rent项目，交易总值约3.154亿澳元。
overview_en: In 2026, UEM Sunrise formed a joint venture with AME Development to develop an integrated managed industrial park in Gerbang Nusajaya and disposed of approximately 402.106 acres of land; it also entered into a development rights agreement with EXSIM for a 1.59-acre commercial land parcel at KLCC, receiving a guaranteed entitlement of RM415.0 million; and progressed a build-to-rent development in Collingwood, Melbourne, with an estimated total transaction value of AUD315.4 million.

segments.name: 产业发展
segments.note: 今年在柔佛Gerbang Nusajaya推进综合管理工业园合资项目，并在墨尔本Collingwood推进build-to-rent开发。
segments.note_en: This year, the segment progressed a joint-venture integrated managed industrial park in Gerbang Nusajaya, Johor, and a build-to-rent development in Collingwood, Melbourne.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 就上述工业园合资项目提供额外资料，包括项目开发总成本等细节。
actions.text_en: Provided additional information on the above industrial park joint venture, including details such as the gross development cost.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 与AME Development成立合资公司GSSB（持股50%），在柔佛Gerbang Nusajaya开发综合管理工业园，并处置约402.106英亩土地。
actions.text_en: Formed a 50%-owned joint venture, GSSB, with AME Development to develop an integrated managed industrial park in Gerbang Nusajaya, Johor, and dispose of approximately 402.106 acres of land.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 通过子公司就墨尔本Collingwood一幅物业签订build-to-rent开发协议，估计交易总值约3.154亿澳元。
actions.text_en: Entered into a build-to-rent development arrangement for a property in Collingwood, Melbourne, via subsidiaries, with an estimated total transaction value of approximately AUD315.4 million.

segments.name: 土地与产业合作
segments.note: 今年就KLCC一幅商业地签订开发权协议，并收取保证权益款项。
segments.note_en: This year, the segment entered into a development rights agreement for a commercial land parcel at KLCC and received the guaranteed entitlement payment.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 就上述开发权协议提供更新，包括收取余额付款后保证权益为4.15亿马币。
actions.text_en: Provided an update on the above development rights agreement, including a guaranteed entitlement of RM415.0 million following receipt of the balance payment.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 间接全资子公司Aurora Tower At KLCC与EXSIM KLCC签订开发权协议，涉及吉隆坡KLCC一幅约1.59英亩商业地。
actions.text_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Aurora Tower At KLCC entered into a development rights agreement with EXSIM KLCC for a commercial land parcel of approximately 1.59 acres at KLCC, Kuala Lumpur.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过合资公司GSSB进入综合管理工业园开发业务，并处置约402.106英亩土地。
model_changes.text_en: Entered the integrated managed industrial park development business through joint venture GSSB and disposed of approximately 402.106 acres of land.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 在墨尔本Collingwood开展build-to-rent开发，估计交易总值约3.154亿澳元。
model_changes.text_en: Undertook a build-to-rent development in Collingwood, Melbourne, with an estimated total transaction value of approximately AUD315.4 million.
